summary.text: Marcus Vaughn is a Republican state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 9th Norfolk District since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He has worked as a chief executive and is the ranking minority member of the House Post Audit and Oversight Committee.

paragraphs.text: He earned a bachelor's degree from Syracuse University in 2008 and a graduate degree from California State University in 2014.
His career experience includes working as a CEO.
Vaughn assumed office on January 4, 2023, succeeding Shawn Dooley.

For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee and the Joint Committees on Economic Development and Emerging Technologies and on Ways and Means, and he is the ranking minority member of the House Operations, Facilities and Security Committee, the House Post Audit and Oversight Committee, and the Joint Committee on Public Safety and Homeland Security.
